name: Black Bean-Sweet Potato Bowl with Mushrooms, Avocado & Crema (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb sweet potato
1 lb cremini mushrooms
¼ small bunch cilantro
½ lime
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Quarter mushrooms and add to the baking sheet with the sweet potato. Drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp paprika
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are browned and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and halve onion. Slice one half crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining onion for later use.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice remaining onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add diced onion and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp chili powder
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans. When the onion is softened, add beans to the skillet and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
While the beans are cooking, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in another small bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the cilantro, then add yogurt, mayo, hot sauce, and spices. Whisk to combine the spicy cilantro crema and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp hot sauce
½ tsp cumin, ground
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Slice half of the avocado lengthwise into ½-inch thick wedges. Slice remaining avocado crosswise into thin half-moons.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 1 cup of roasted veggies, ⅔ cup of beans, avocado wedges, and yogurt between plates. 



FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining veggies, beans, avocado slices, and pickled onions between plates. Drizzle with spicy cilantro crema and enjoy!
